name: proof
title: One script, real GitHub and a local GitLab
part: For real: two forges, one vocabulary
html:
One script, real GitHub and a local GitLab

On the wire, compatible because of the typed relation. One YAML connector per forge maps its native API to scm:merge, scm:comment… The GitLab runs make no cloud calls and no model calls.
say: Same kept script, same scm: relations. GitHub is the real cloud service; GitLab runs locally with no cloud calls. Each forge has one YAML connector in the gateway that maps its native API to the same typed relations, so scm:merge means the same on both. On the wire, compatible because of the typed relation. So what did all that cost? And how was it built, a few sentences at a time?
